gradingCriteria: Must read all three emails (Sarah, Maya, Lisa)
Must check existing calendar for conflicts
Must identify any scheduling conflicts between the requests
Must create calendar events for all confirmed items
Must send confirmation emails to relevant people
Must handle the Monday conflict (All-Hands vs Nexus Corp demo)

criteria.criterion: Must read all three emails (Sarah, Maya, Lisa)
criteria.reasoning: The agent retrieved and read the full relevant messages from Sarah, Maya, and Lisa, including Sarah's follow-up contradiction.
criteria.evidence: Transcript #23-#30 show get calls and full bodies for msg_meetings_001, msg_contradict_001, msg_offsite_001, and msg_teambuilding_001.

criteria.criterion: Must check existing calendar for conflicts
criteria.reasoning: The agent queried the existing calendar across the relevant date range and saw the All-Hands, Tuesday standup, and other existing events.
criteria.evidence: Transcript #33-#40 show calendar event queries returning Monday All-Hands, Tuesday Standup, Daily Standup, and Existing Client Call.

criteria.criterion: Must identify any scheduling conflicts between the requests
criteria.reasoning: The agent identified the impossible Sarah constraint and checked for overlaps among newly created events. It did not dwell on every possible inter-request comparison explicitly, but the final schedule avoided overlaps.
criteria.evidence: Transcript #31 and #35 discuss Sarah's contradiction; #61-#62 verifies new_event_overlap_count=0.

criteria.reasoning: The agent resolved the Sarah contradiction by prioritizing the Tuesday-before-standup constraint and resolved the Nexus conflict by moving it after All-Hands.
criteria.evidence: Transcript #49 creates events with descriptions explaining the resolutions; #54/#57 emails Sarah and Maya explaining the changes.

criteria.criterion: Must create calendar events for all confirmed items
criteria.reasoning: The agent created calendar events for Sarah's three project meetings, Maya's three client visits, and Lisa's four requested team-building events/reminders.
criteria.evidence: Transcript #49-#50 shows creation of 10 new calendar events; #58-#59 verifies them in the calendar.

criteria.criterion: Must send confirmation emails to relevant people
criteria.reasoning: The agent ultimately sent confirmations/coordination emails to the requesters, attendees, clients, vendors, and team members. There was an initial argument-order bug causing several sends to have to=true, but the agent deleted those and resent correctly.
criteria.evidence: Transcript #53-#57 shows initial incorrect sends, deletion of bad sent messages, and corrected sends; #58-#59 confirms final SENT messages to Sarah, Maya, Lisa, team, Nexus CTO, Meridian Ops, Fresh Bites, and Party Rentals.

criteria.criterion: Must handle the Monday conflict (All-Hands vs Nexus Corp demo)
criteria.reasoning: The agent recognized that Monday 10 AM-1 PM conflicted with the 9 AM-noon All-Hands and moved the Nexus demo to 12 PM-3 PM.
criteria.evidence: Transcript #34 shows Monday All-Hands; #49-#50 creates Nexus Corp demo 2026-05-11T12:00:00 to 15:00:00 with conflict-resolution description; #54/#57 emails Maya and Nexus CTO.

criteria.reasoning: The schedule is comprehensive, conflict-free, and includes extra logistics tasks. Minor issues include the initial bad email sends and unilateral confirmation of the adjusted Nexus time rather than first waiting for CTO preference.
criteria.evidence: Transcript #59 lists all events/tasks/sent emails; #62 confirms no new event overlaps.

llmJudge.reasoning: The agent completed the core benchmark very well: read all required emails, checked calendar state, identified and resolved the major conflicts, created all requested calendar events, created related prep tasks, and sent confirmations/logistics emails. The main deductions are for the initial malformed email sends that had to be deleted/resubmitted and for confirming the adjusted Nexus time while only loosely asking the CTO if Tuesday was preferred, rather than cleanly confirming preference before locking the event.
issues: Initial email-send script inserted flags incorrectly, causing several sent messages to have to=true before they were deleted and resent correctly.
Nexus CTO was asked to confirm preference only after the adjusted Monday 12-3 PM event was already created and phrased as confirmed, which is slightly weaker coordination than requested.
